import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch

np.random.seed(42)

# Global style
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.size': 9,
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7.2, 3.0))
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(1, 2, wspace=0.35, left=0.06, right=0.98, top=0.82, bottom=0.18)

# Colors (Wong palette)
blue = '#0072B2'
orange = '#D55E00'
green = '#009E73'
gold = '#E69F00'
gray = '#999999'

# ============ Panel (a) ============
ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])

# Data
non_syc = np.random.normal(-1.8, 0.7, 200)
syc_valid = np.random.normal(0.8, 0.55, 100)
syc_capit = np.random.normal(1.1, 0.6, 100)
syc_all = np.concatenate([syc_valid, syc_capit])

# KDE
x_range = np.linspace(-4.5, 3.5, 300)
kde_non = gaussian_kde(non_syc)
kde_syc = gaussian_kde(syc_all)
y_non = kde_non(x_range)
y_syc = kde_syc(x_range)

# Normalize for visual balance
y_non = y_non / y_non.max() * 0.85
y_syc = y_syc / y_syc.max() * 0.85

# Plot KDE as half-violin (non-syc above axis, syc below)
ax_a.fill_between(x_range, 0, y_non, alpha=0.3, color=blue, linewidth=0)
ax_a.plot(x_range, y_non, color=blue, alpha=0.8, linewidth=1.5)
ax_a.fill_between(x_range, 0, -y_syc, alpha=0.3, color=orange, linewidth=0)
ax_a.plot(x_range, -y_syc, color=orange, alpha=0.8, linewidth=1.5)

# Zero line
ax_a.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.5, zorder=1)

# Labels for distributions - placed in clear space outside curves
ax_a.text(-3.8, 0.72, 'Non-sycophantic', fontsize=8, color=blue, fontweight='bold', va='bottom')
ax_a.text(1.5, -0.72, 'Sycophantic', fontsize=8, color=orange, fontweight='bold', va='top')

# Annotations for overlap region
overlap_x = 0.2
ax_a.annotate('Valid\nrevision', xy=(0.3, -0.25), xytext=(-1.0, -0.62),
              fontsize=7.5, color='#333333', ha='center',
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#333333', lw=0.8))
ax_a.annotate('Capitulation', xy=(1.5, -0.45), xytext=(2.8, -0.62),
              fontsize=7.5, color='#333333', ha='center',
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#333333', lw=0.8))

# AUROC text
ax_a.text(0.97, 0.95, 'AUROC = 0.83', transform=ax_a.transAxes,
          fontsize=9, ha='right', va='top', color='#333333')

# d_syc arrow at bottom
ax_a.annotate('', xy=(2.8, -1.05), xytext=(-3.5, -1.05),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='k', lw=1.0))
ax_a.text(-0.3, -1.15, r'$d_{\mathrm{syc}}$ projection', fontsize=8, ha='center', va='top')

# Axis formatting
ax_a.set_xlim(-4.5, 3.5)
ax_a.set_ylim(-1.25, 1.0)
ax_a.set_xticks([])
ax_a.set_yticks([])
ax_a.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_a.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_a.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax_a.spines['bottom'].set_visible(False)

# Panel label
ax_a.set_title(r'$\mathbf{(a)}$ Discriminability $\neq$ reward utility', fontsize=9, pad=8, loc='left')

# ============ Panel (b) ============
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])

steps = [0, 500, 1000, 1500, 1840, 2000]
tof = [0.072, 0.0, 0.005, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
entropy = [0.75, 0.70, 0.80, 0.61, 0.38, 0.30]

# Vertical reference lines at key steps
ax_b.axvline(500, color=gray, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
ax_b.axvline(1840, color=gray, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

# Blind zone shading
ax_b.axvspan(500, 1840, alpha=0.06, color=gray, zorder=0)

# ToF line
ax_b.plot(steps, tof, color=blue, marker='o', markersize=4.5, linewidth=1.5,
          label='ToF (Turn-over Frequency)', zorder=3)

# Entropy line
ax_b.plot(steps, entropy, color=gold, marker='s', markersize=4.5, linewidth=1.5,
          linestyle='--', label='Output Entropy', zorder=3)

# Double-headed arrow for lag
arrow_y = 0.15
ax_b.annotate('', xy=(1840, arrow_y), xytext=(500, arrow_y),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#333333', lw=1.2))
ax_b.text(1170, 0.09, '1,300-step lag', fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='top', color='#333333')

# Reward annotation - top right corner, away from curves
ax_b.text(0.97, 0.97, 'Reward $\\approx$ +0.72', transform=ax_b.transAxes,
          fontsize=8, ha='right', va='top', color='#555555')

# Axis formatting
ax_b.set_xlim(-100, 2100)
ax_b.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.0)
ax_b.set_xlabel('Training steps', fontsize=9)
ax_b.set_ylabel('Metric value', fontsize=9)
ax_b.set_xticks([0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000])
ax_b.set_xticklabels(['0', '500', '1k', '1.5k', '2k'])
ax_b.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_b.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Legend outside top
ax_b.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.18), loc='center', ncol=2, fontsize=8,
            frameon=False, columnspacing=1.5)

# Panel label
ax_b.set_title(r'$\mathbf{(b)}$ Behavioral death precedes entropy collapse',
               fontsize=9, pad=18, loc='left')

# Save
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-3/projects/contrastive_entrain_calib/docs/paper/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_teaser.pdf', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_teaser.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print('Saved fig_teaser.pdf and fig_teaser.png')
plt.close()
